Package com.hkust.marketplace.repositories

Class UserRepository

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.repositories.UserRepository
public class UserRepository extends Object
MySQL persistence for accounts in the users table.

Provides lookups, registration, profile and active-state updates, password-hash migration, and permanent deletion. Deletion runs in one transaction and updates related deals, chats, listings, and notifications before removing the account row.

  • Method Details

    • findByUsername

      public User findByUsername(Connection connection, String username) throws SQLException
      Re-reads an account while holding a shared (FOR SHARE) lock for a caller-owned business transaction.

      The caller owns the connection and its commit/rollback; this method never commits, rolls back, or closes it.

      Parameters:
      connection - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      username - the account's username
      Returns:
      the account, or null when no such username exists
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when connection is null or auto-commit is enabled
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • register

      public void register(User user) throws SQLException
      Inserts a new account, using a connection owned by this method.

      The password hash must already be an Argon2id hash; hashing and credential checks belong to the caller. A duplicate username aborts before anything is inserted.

      Parameters:
      user - the account to insert; its username, full name, hash, role and profile fields are written
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the password hash is not a valid Argon2id hash or the username already exists
      SQLException - when the insert fails

      public boolean updateProfile(User user, String passwordHash) throws SQLException

      public boolean updatePasswordHash(String username, String hash) throws SQLException
      Stores an already hashed password, using a new connection.

      Authentication and authorization belong to the caller. The stored hash is replaced unconditionally for a matching username.

      Parameters:

      hash - the new Argon2id hash
      Returns:

      Throws:

      SQLException - when the update fails

    • replacePasswordHash

      public boolean replacePasswordHash(String username, String previous, String hash) throws SQLException
      Replaces the password hash only when the stored value is exactly the supplied previous hash, comparing bytes instead of relying on the case-insensitive database collation.

      This is a compare-and-set used by the legacy-hash migration. The connection is opened and closed here; a concurrent change of the stored hash makes the update fail.

      Parameters:
      username - the account whose hash is updated
      previous - the exact hash that must still be stored
      hash - the new Argon2id hash to store
      Returns:
      true when the stored hash equalled previous and was replaced, false otherwise
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when hash is not a valid Argon2id hash
      SQLException - when the update fails

    • deleteUser

      public void deleteUser(String username) throws SQLException
      Permanently deletes a buyer/seller account in one transaction:
      1. locks/validates the account first, so retrying a deletion is idempotent (a missing account aborts before any counter is touched);
      2. marks the seller's listings REMOVED and deletes the user's notifications;
      3. increments the participant-deletion counter (deleted, capped at 2) on every deal and chat thread they participate in, cancelling still-open deals when one participant remains;
      4. deletes the user row; the deals/chat/listing FKs use ON DELETE SET NULL, so the preserved records keep the remaining participant.
      Admin accounts cannot be removed here. The account row is locked with FOR UPDATE before any related write, so a concurrent deletion cannot double-apply the counters. The connection and transaction are owned by this method; it commits on success and rolls back on failure.
      Parameters:
      username - the buyer/seller username to delete permanently; it is trimmed first
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the username is missing, unknown or an admin
      SQLException - when any statement fails; the transaction is rolled back
